body:
Filing gate: maintainer-directed task. Filed by the 18.2.0 release-assessment thread · `session_01G3h9iZTpL8aCiXbfsp8H5u`. ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not dispatched.

**Maintainer's words** (project thread, 2026-10-25, verbatim): 22:54Z 「约 300 条清单准确性问题：是不是应该开卡？」, then 22:55Z 「写issue，不派发」.

**Parent:** wave anchor #25807 (18.2.0 release test sweep). RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/automation.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (24)

### From #25812 — `priority:P0`, 23 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- `automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable`: steps 2/8/10 task POST needs `project`; step 4's "reads are open" holds only at the apiMethods layer (a contributor gets 403 on `sys_metadata_activation`).

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `automation.durable-suspend-restart` a0/a1/a4: the pin drives its own fixture (flow_durable_suspend, a screen-node pause) — not the showcase showcase_task_follow_up timer or the showcase_project_closure → showcase_closure_signoff nested pair the steps name; the generic persistence/consumption assertions hold, the per-kind rows are not observed
- `automation.durable-suspend-restart` a1: the pin's 'cold boot' is a second bootStack kernel over the same file inside one test process, not a separately spawned server process
- `automation.flow-authoring-refusals-v18` ref is accurate: it scopes the nine unit files to acceptance[0] only and says a1-a3 are manual; all nine files exist with ≥1 test
- `automation.flow-run-semantics-v18` a2/n0: the ref's two elevated-door pins (packages/runtime/src/{action,endpoint}-flow-elevated-door.test.ts) are unit door pins over a scripted automation service and never drive the trigger door the step names (POST /automation/:name/trigger); the wire pins that do — packages/verify/src/automation-trigger-elevated-door.test.ts (HTTP injection, 403 PERMISSION_DENIED, runs 0 by listRuns) and packages/qa/dogfood/test/flow-door-elevated-start.dogfood.test.ts — are not in the ref (the runtime file's own header names them as the wire half)
- `automation.flow-run-semantics-v18` a1: no pin in the ref reads back a field a record-triggered run stamped over HTTP; flow-cel-current-user.test.ts drives the engine only
- `automation.inbound-hook-timestamped-signature` a2: no pin byte-compares the refusal arms' bodies against each other; rows assert code + typeof message only (member-vs-mount parity is per row, not across arms)
- `automation.paused-run-trigger-record-masked` a0: the column parse is an engine (isSystem) read of sys_automation_run, plus an HTTP data-door read that checks only variables_json.record; 'null where unset' is not exercised
- `automation.paused-run-trigger-record-masked` a3: the 'second process' is a second bootStack over the same SQLite file inside the same vitest process, not a spawned server
- `automation.paused-run-trigger-record-masked` n0: every reader in the pin is the dev admin token; 'whichever persona reads it' is not driven across personas
- `automation.scheduled-work-opt-in` a1/a2: both pins assert that flows are ARMED (or not) and the refusal sentence on a LiteKernel; neither observes a served boot log line or run rows after intervals
- `automation.screen-flow-roundtrip` a4: the spec's final assertion is page.getByText(assignee) on the grid — exactly the 'not just the refreshed grid cell' the clause excludes
- `automation.screen-flow-roundtrip` a0/a3: the spec never reads the run (status paused/completed); only request capture and UI toast
- `automation.setup-packaged-automation-board` a0: the objectui ref→URL half names PackagedAutomationPage.navContribution.test.tsx (exists at the pin) in the clause's verify but not in automated.ref; it is component-layer and scores nothing either way.
- `automation.trigger-type-matrix` n0: names packages/qa/dogfood/test/showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces.dogfood.test.ts › 'anonymous POST /automation/:name/trigger is denied (401)' (exists, line 587) but the file is not in automated.ref, so a ref-driven run never executes it

### From #25817 — `release-18.2.0-manual-set`, 29 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956`

- `automation.trigger-status-contract`: steps[7] asks for "the SAME disabled flow" through `/actions` and an endpoint, but no stock flow is reachable from all three doors.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract`: The runner used `showcase_reassign_wizard` with `showcase_bulk_reassign`, and `showcase_inquiry_purge` with its endpoint.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract`: The `/actions` 400 and 422 rows need a type:'flow' action. The recipe could add `PUT /api/v1/meta/action/NAME?package=com.objectstack.qa.automation`.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract`: The recipe knownGap "NOT yet proven by a live run" is stale.
- `automation.trigger-status-contract`: A bodyless resume of the stock wizard answers 400 `INVALID_SCREEN_INPUT`, not 200.
- `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal`: knownGaps[0] is partly stale: a tenant caller can be authored through `POST /api/v1/automation`, and it does not guard.
- `automation.packaged-flow-subflow-disable-refusal`: A `?package=`-authored flow counts as deployment-authored (the toggle answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` "authored in this deployment"). So the self-caller arm and N1 need a package-loader-installed package.
- `automation.packaged-flow-clone-contract`: For `{}`, A0's `details` names only the first missing field.
- automation.flow-run-step-nesting steps[4]: the Studio route is `/_console/studio/com.example.showcase/automations?surface=flow:NAME`, then the Runs tab; probe flows are under `~org`.

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
